'''Communications Bunker 33''' was a communications installation built in the northwestern corner of the [[Cartel mining mesa]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makeb]]. The bunker was one of many such installations across Makeb that were used by the [[InterStellar Regulators]], the planet's [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] defense force that was bought off by the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] prior to the [[Conquest of Makeb]]. During the conflict, the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] captured the bunker and established it as their foothold on the mesa.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Communications Bunker 33 was added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' along with the rest of the planet Makeb in the [[2013]] Digital Expansion ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
